camel_example: aliyun ecs ModifyDiskAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --DiskIds.1 'd-bp1famypsnar20bv****' --BurstingEnabled false --Description TestDescription --DeleteWithInstance false --DeleteAutoSnapshot false --EnableAutoSnapshot true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DiskName MyDiskName --DiskId 'd-bp1famypsnar20bv****'
description_en: Modifies the attributes of one or more block storage devices, such as the name, description, release behavior with the instance, automatic snapshot deletion behavior, automatic snapshot policy, and performance burst feature
description_zh: 修改一个或多个块存储设备的名称、描述、是否随实例释放、是否随磁盘删除其自动快照、是否启用自动快照策略、是否开启性能突发功能等
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-disk-attribute --disk-id 'd-bp1famypsnar20bv****' --disk-name MyDiskName --description TestDescription --delete-with-instance false --delete-auto-snapshot false --enable-auto-snapshot true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --disk-ids '["d-bp1famypsnar20bv****"]' --bursting-enabled false --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDiskAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the disk whose attributes you want to modify.
You cannot specify both the DiskId and DiskIds.N parameters. Specify one of them based on your requirements
parameters.help_zh:
待修改属性的磁盘ID。
`DiskId`和`DiskIds.N`两个参数不能同时被调用，请您根据需求任选其一传值
parameters.name: disk_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the disk. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters and digits in Unicode. It can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 磁盘名称。长度为2~128个字符，支持Unicode中letter分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文和数字等）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: disk_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the disk. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 磁盘描述。 长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the disk is released along with the instance. Default value: null. A value of null indicates that the current value remains unchanged.

<props="china">This parameter is not supported for disks that have the multi-attach feature enabled.</props>

An error is returned if you set the `DeleteWithInstance` parameter to `false` in either of the following scenarios: 
         
The disk category is local disk (ephemeral).  
The disk category is basic disk (cloud) and the disk is not detachable (Portable=false).  

<warning>If you configure the disk not to be released with the instance (DeleteWithInstance=false), the disk is still released along with the instance if the ECS instance to which the disk is attached is locked for security reasons and the OperationLocks parameter indicates a lock status of "LockReason":"security". In this case, the DeleteWithInstance attribute of the disk is ignored.></warning>
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘是否随实例释放。默认值：无，无表示不改变当前的值。

<props="china">开启多重挂载特性的云盘，不支持设置该参数。</props>

在下列两种情况下，将参数`DeleteWithInstance`设置成`false`时会报错。 
         
磁盘的种类（category）为本地盘（ephemeral）时。  
磁盘的种类（category）为普通云盘（cloud），且不可以卸载（Portable=false）时。  

<warning>如果您设置了不随实例释放（DeleteWithInstance=false），一旦磁盘挂载的ECS实例被安全锁定且OperationLocks中标记了"LockReason" : "security"的锁定状态，释放实例时会忽略磁盘的DeleteWithInstance属性而被同时释放。></warning>
parameters.name: delete_with_instance

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete the automatic snapshots of the disk when the disk is deleted. Valid values:

true: Yes.

false: No.

Default value: null. A null value indicates that the current value is not changed
parameters.help_zh:
删除磁盘时，是否同时删除其自动快照。取值范围：

true：启用。

false：关闭。

默认值：无，无表示不改变当前的值
parameters.name: delete_auto_snapshot

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the automatic snapshot policy feature for the disk. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No.

Default value: null. A null value indicates that the current value is not changed.

[Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated. The automatic snapshot policy feature is enabled by default for newly created disks. You only need to apply an automatic snapshot policy to the disk
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘是否启用自动快照策略功能。取值范围：

true：启用。
false：关闭。

默认值：无，表示不改变当前的值。

该参数已弃用。创建后的云盘默认启用自动快照策略功能，您只需要为云盘绑定自动快照策略即可正常使用
parameters.name: enable_auto_snapshot

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the disks whose attributes you want to modify. Valid values of N: 0 to 100.
You cannot specify both the DiskId and DiskIds.N parameters. Specify one of them based on your requirements
parameters.help_zh:
待修改多个磁盘的ID列表。N的取值范围为0 ~ 100。
`DiskId`和`DiskIds.N`两个参数不能同时被调用，请您根据需求任选其一传值
parameters.name: disk_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the performance burst feature for a disk that supports this feature. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No.

An error is returned if you specify this parameter for a disk that does not support the performance burst feature
parameters.help_zh:
针对支持Burst（性能突发）的磁盘是否开启此功能，取值范围：

true：是。
false：否。

对于不支持Burst功能的磁盘，传入任意值将会报错
parameters.name: bursting_enabled
